name: cascaded-voice-pipeline
explain: Implement a cascaded voice agent pipeline connecting Voice Activity Detection (VAD), Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), LLM reasoning, and Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis with per-stage latency budgeting and error boundaries.
steps: Feed microphone audio frames through energy-based VAD to detect speech boundaries. || Transcribe speech to text, generate agent response tokens, and synthesize audio frames while tracking stage latencies.
expect: Cascaded voice pipeline verified: audio_bytes=82, response_phrase='store exchange only', stages_completed=4

name: partial-transcript-reconciliation
explain: Handle non-monotonic streaming ASR hypotheses. Enables speculative interim transcript updates for live UI captions while strictly gating consequential backend tool mutations on finalized transcripts.
steps: Ingest interim ASR hypotheses to update speculative UI captions without triggering sensitive tools. || Enforce finalization check, executing the committed business action only after receiving the final transcript.
expect: Partial transcript reconciliation verified: interim_gated=True, final_executed=True, executed_action='keep_order_active'

name: adaptive-turn-detection
explain: Implement adaptive conversational turn detection combining acoustic silence duration with syntactic completeness heuristics. Dynamically expands silence windows on incomplete clauses to protect cognitive pauses.
steps: Evaluate turn completion on syntactically complete sentences using standard silence thresholds. || Detect incomplete trailing syntax or hesitation, expanding threshold windows to prevent premature user cut-offs.
expect: Adaptive turn detection verified: complete_detected=True, hesitation_protected=True, extended_threshold=1200ms

name: barge-in-interruption-controller
explain: Coordinate client-server state during user barge-in. Clears local audio buffers, sends cancellation signals to abort backend TTS synthesis, and advances generation epochs to fence out stale audio frames.
steps: Detect user speech during active playback, instantly purging local client audio queues. || Abort backend TTS generation and advance the generation epoch to discard delayed stale audio frames.
expect: Barge-in interruption controller verified: buffer_purged=True, generation_advanced_to=2, stale_frames_dropped=1, new_turn_accepted=True

name: voice-confirmation-policy
explain: Enforce formal verification protocols for sensitive voice-driven operations. Distinguishes ASR phonetic confidence from authorization, enforces exact parameter readback, and invalidates confirmations upon parameter changes.
steps: Require explicit parameter readback and user confirmation before committing high-risk operations. || Invalidate pending confirmation state when parameters mutate, preventing stale approvals.
expect: Voice confirmation policy verified: parameters_verified=True, stale_confirmation_prevented=True, committed_amount=$250.00

name: voice-privacy-lifecycle
explain: Enforce privacy and accessibility governance for voice agents by discarding raw biometric audio in RAM, redacting PII from stored transcripts, and providing an accessible parallel text fallback channel.
steps: Process incoming voice audio in RAM and discard raw PCM bytes immediately upon transcription. || Redact credit card numbers and SSNs from transcripts, and fall back to text chat when mic access is denied.
expect: Voice privacy lifecycle verified: raw_audio_retained=False, pii_masked=True, text_fallback_available=True

name: pcm-audio-frame-calculator
explain: Calculate uncompressed PCM audio byte throughput, samples per frame, and jitter buffer sizing across audio configurations, comparing raw PCM bandwidth with compressed Opus streams.
steps: Compute uncompressed audio throughput from sample rate, channel count, and bit depth. || Calculate 20ms frame buffer byte allocations and maximum jitter buffer memory budgets.
expect: PCM audio frame calculator verified: throughput_16k=32000 B/s, frame_20ms_bytes=640, jitter_buffer_budget=8000 B

name: voice-agent-evaluation-matrix
explain: Evaluate voice agent conversational quality across five critical dimensions: Word Error Rate (WER), Intent Recognition Accuracy, Time to First Audio Frame (TTFA), Barge-in Latency, and Audio Leak Prevention.
steps: Benchmark high-quality turns against latency, recognition, and interruption thresholds. || Detect defect runs where high transcription accuracy masks severe barge-in latency or obsolete audio leaks.
expect: Voice evaluation matrix verified: benchmark_passed=True, leak_failure_detected=True

name: interruption-lifecycle-reconciliation
explain: Reconcile decoupled lifecycles between client audio playback and backend tool execution during user barge-in. Proves that stopping speaker audio does not undo committed backend tool transactions, triggering compensating actions.
steps: Cancel in-flight backend tool operations when interrupted before database commitment. || Detect interruptions that occur after a tool commits, preserving the transaction receipt and triggering a compensation flow.
expect: Interruption lifecycle reconciliation verified: audio_stopped=True, inflight_cancelled=True, committed_compensated=True, receipt_preserved=rec_flight_seat_902
